body:
## Summary
- Read-only requests can select configured tiers and use a configured fallback for unsupported routes, with fallback reporting.
- Workspace path validation recognizes carried directories and matching globs while retaining missing-workspace refusals.
- Held summaries flag numeric values absent from added changes, and shared contract guidance records fixed values and tests.
- Integration refuses work-folder references in changed source and test files, while validation warns about build scratch data in context.
- Notes append real UTC timestamps to task or handoff files without executing note text.
